name: Pawan's Home
line: Hi, I'm Pawan. This whole world is my portfolio, so fly around!

card.title: Pawan
card.subtitle: Full-stack web developer
card.body: I build web products end to end, from UI to APIs to deployment. Every glowing landmark in this world is a piece of my work or my story.

card.title: ScanlyFix
card.subtitle: Greninja's project · my best work
card.body: A free web scanner: 114 checks across security, SEO, AI-answer visibility, performance, accessibility and compliance. It gives you fix prompts for AI editors, opens auto-fix pull requests, runs pentest agents, and has a CLI, API and MCP server. Built with Next.js.

card.body: A no-code AI support chatbot trained on your own docs and FAQs. You add it to any site with a one-line embed. Admins control every answer, and it supports 50+ languages, lead capture and integrations.
